title: 1985 Nepal bombings: A series of bomb blasts occurs in Kathmandu and other cities of Nepal.
text: A series of coordinated bomb blasts occurred on 20 June 1985 in Kathmandu and other cities in Nepal. This spate of bomb attacks was the first of its kind in the country.

title: कुसुमे रुमाल
text: कुसुमे रुमाल तुलसी घिमिरेद्वारा लिखित र निर्देशित नेपाली शृंगारिक चलचित्र हो। सयपत्री फिल्मसको ब्यानरमा सुमित्रा पौडेलद्वारा यो चलचित्र प्रस्तुत गरिएको हो। नेपालमा बनेका नेपाली भाषाका चलचित्रहरूमा यो २०औँ क्रममा आउँछ। तुलसी घिमिरेको निर्देशनमा बनेकामध्ये भने यो दोस्रो चलचित्र हो। भनिन्छ, यही चलचित्रले पहिलपटक प्रदर्शनको रजत जयन्ती मनाएको थियो।

title: Kusume Rumal
text: Kusume Rumal is a 1985 Nepali romantic film written and directed by Tulsi Ghimire. It was produced by Sumitra Paudel under the banner of Sayapatri Films.

title: Basudev
text: Basudev is a 1984 Nepali language film, adapted from Dhruba Chandra Gautam's Kattel Sarko Chotpatak by Neer Shah in his directorial debut. The film starred Harihar Sharma as the eponymous character, with Shakuntala Sharma, Subhadra Adhikari, Krishna Malla, Sharmila Malla and director Shah himself in supporting roles, while Madan Krishna Shrestha and Hari Bansha Acharya were credited as guest actors.
